primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in serum ALT at Month 4.
efficacy_outcome: At Month 4, serum ALT changed by −53.89% with roflumilast plus pioglitazone, −56.22% with roflumilast alone, and −28.86% with pioglitazone alone; statistical comparisons were not reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 0/7 participants in the combination group, 0/7 with roflumilast alone, and 0/6 with pioglitazone alone; deaths were not reported.
